notes.note: Fix-round scoped review: the host adapter now preserves the pre-migration no-op for turn terminals without a nonempty provider ID; session-level retirement remains unchanged. The production-authority regression failed before the guard and passed after; removing the guard from a clean commit failed the same retained-row assertion, and exact restoration passed. The frozen SQL fixture Error constructor was typed without changing SQL behavior. Reviewed the SessionTurnBoundaryAuthority composition and caller path. Boundary writes/listing now run through sqlite-session-turn-boundary and Monument; sealed-task admission stays in the transaction, storage errors retain host classification, and EventStore owns the outer append commit. Physical terminal reconciliation, liveness and opaque capabilities remain host-owned. Production peer-visibility and rollback tests now call the real authority; frozen pre-migration SQL is independent of the package. No provider, native or publication qualification claimed.
